request: Implement the full bounded OpenSRE integration for HivemindOS: durable incident bundles, SRE provider capability, pinned read-only sidecar contract, watchdog escalation wiring, approvals-safe report handling, and synthetic incident evaluation.

entries.note: Adapted the reviewed loopback health and POST /investigate request-response contract behind HivemindOS validation, timeouts, authentication, redaction, and provider policy.
Mapped structured RCA concepts into the smaller HivemindOS diagnosis record while adding explicit recommendation-only and HivemindOS execution-authority fields.
Adapted bounded investigation and terminal-result concepts into a durable single-concurrency local queue without importing OpenSRE orchestration or remediation.
Converted documented privacy controls into enforced managed-service defaults with a minimal environment; the interactive shell is rejected.
Adapted required/forbidden keyword and evidence-based RCA scoring to hermetic HivemindOS golden incidents.
